authorFixedSemantics.constructionUnit: physical meaning of one numerical model unit; changing it is physical reinterpretation, never geometric scaling, coordinate transformation or redefine
authorFixedSemantics.legacyDocument: no unit metadata -> constructionUnit = UNSPECIFIED_MODEL_UNIT; cm never inferred from printingScale, zoom, DPI, viewport or historical exporter behavior
authorFixedSemantics.AQ-U1: RESOLVED — AUTHOR CONFIRMED (2026-10-01): printed/exported physical dimension invariant under an equivalent presentationUnit change

decisions.decision: v1: only the native dimension objects delivered by E2 present physical units; Distance, Length, LocusLength and other existing numeric results stay model-unit values without physical suffix; general GeoNumeric objects are not turned into dimensional quantities; areas, volumes and other unit powers outside D0 v1; angles stay under the independent angleUnit contract

physical construction units v1: mm, cm, m, usm, plus the non-physical state UNSPECIFIED_MODEL_UNIT; exact factors mm = 10^-3 m, cm = 10^-2 m, m = 1 m; usm is one document-scoped user-defined physical unit with durable semantic identity token usm and definition 1 usm = k m, k finite and > 0; the factor must be explicitly defined before usm can become the effective construction or presentation unit; an absent or invalid factor never falls back to an inferred value and never turns usm into UNSPECIFIED_MODEL_UNIT; name and symbol are presentation metadata, not semantic identity; renaming without changing the factor does not change physical semantics; changing the factor while usm is active is a physical reinterpretation (no coordinate change, no scaling, no DAG change, no identity change, undoable, dependent dimensional presentation and export interpretation update); an invalid attempted factor change is rejected and the previous valid definition stays; one usm definition per document in v1, no custom-unit registry in D0/D1; presentationUnit may use the same definition; constructionUnit = usm without explicit presentationUnit -> effective presentationUnit = usm; a standard construction unit may present in usm when a valid definition exists; serialized tokens exactly mm, cm, m, usm; UNSPECIFIED_MODEL_UNIT is the absence of construction-unit metadata, never a token; when usm is referenced its metre factor is serialized in the same flat, versioned, self-closing GeoCeDG unit element in a locale-independent, deterministic, round-trip-reproducible lexical form; exact element and attribute names are a D0 decision; the custom-unit definition is never inside geocedgSpatial; older GeoCeDG and Classic stay lenient, unknown unit metadata may be ignored and lost on re-save, and D0 documents this limitation

copy/paste moves numeric geometry, not physical lengths; never converts coordinates or scales geometry; both physical with different effective metre factors: accept, keep values exactly, non-blocking notice, no implicit conversion; one or both unspecified: accept, keep values, infer no unit, no scaling; compatibility/warning logic compares effective metre factors, not only tokens (two usm documents with different factors produce the notice); the notice is not geometry and not part of the paste undo beyond the paste's normal behavior
drawingScale is SESSION, default 1:1, not serialized, not undoable, reset on New/Open; export/presentation state, not geometric semantics

with UNSPECIFIED_MODEL_UNIT no engineering-scale physical export exists; the user must declare a physical unit before an engineering drawing scale with physical meaning, IsoABorder or any operation converting model units to a physical magnitude; no implicit 1 unit = 1 cm fallback; dimensions show only the bare model value without suffix; UNSPECIFIED_MODEL_UNIT is the only state without physical model-unit interpretation; a valid usm enables engineering-scale export and IsoABorder exactly like mm, cm or m; an undefined usm cannot be selected and does not enable physical export

constructionUnit change = one undoable document operation; presentationUnit change = one undoable document operation; usm factor change while active = undoable; drawingScale not undoable; changing the user preference used as default for new documents = no document undo; undo/redo restore unit and dimensional presentation coherently without changing identity or geometry

constructionUnit, presentationUnit and drawingScale MUST NOT alter live coordinates, authoritative numeric geometry, DAG topology, dependencies, semantic identities, construction order, geometric object identity, LocusV2 branch/component identity, LocusV2 semantics, SplineV2 semantics, parameter domains or numeric geometric outputs; the only live consumers are dimension presentation strings, status/presentation UI and export adapters; a tool may read unit/scale once at creation to compute an explicit model-unit input, which then is an ordinary construction parameter not following later unit changes; no live geometric dependency on units

flat, versioned, self-closing GeoCeDG element under <construction>, conceptually <geocedgUnits version="1" construction="mm" presentation="cm"/>, final names by D0; lazy writing; absence = unspecified; no automatic writing for legacy documents; reset in clearConstruction, not by absence during parse; paste does not reset the target unit; macro constructions neither write nor consume the element; flat, no children; no preferences XML; coherent undo snapshot; legacy byte identity without units

D0 writes the normative amendment of geocedg/specs/export/geometry-export-foundation.md: model coordinates stay unconverted; DXF $INSUNITS derives from constructionUnit in C/D1; $INSUNITS = 0 while unspecified; screen scale, printingScale and DPI are never reinterpreted as model unit; D0 does not modify the exporter
